=== Drops === Rules controlling [[item]] drops from blocks, entities, and mobs, including drop decay mechanics. {| class="wikitable sortable collapsible" ! Rule name ! class="unsortable" | Description ! Default value ! Type ! Availability in ''Bedrock Edition'' |- | {{el|je|short=1}}: {{va|block_drops}}
{{el|be|short=1}}: {{va|dotiledrops}} | Whether blocks should have drops. | style="text-align:center" | {{cd|true}} | Bool | {{tc|yes|Without cheats}}These game rules are available under "Advanced" section of the world menus (e.g., [[World Options]] and [[Create New World]]). |- | {{va|block_explosion_drop_decay}} | Whether block loot is dropped by all blocks ({{cd|false}}) or randomly ({{cd|true}}) depending on how far the block is from the center of a block explosion (e.g. clicking a bed in dimensions other than the Overworld). | style="text-align:center" | {{cd|true}} | Bool | {{tc|no|''Java Edition'' exclusive}} |- | {{el|je|short=1}}: {{va|entity_drops}}
{{el|be|short=1}}: {{va|doentitydrops}} | Whether entities that are not mobs should have drops. | style="text-align:center" | {{cd|true}} | Bool | {{tc|partial|Cheats only}} |- | {{el|je|short=1}}: {{va|mob_drops}}
{{el|be|short=1}}: {{va|domobloot}} | Whether mobs should [[drops|drop items]] and [[experience]] orbs. | style="text-align:center" | {{cd|true}} | Bool | {{tc|yes|Without cheats}} |- | {{va|mob_explosion_drop_decay}} | Whether block loot is dropped by all blocks ({{cd|false}}) or randomly ({{cd|true}}) depending on how far the block is from the center of a mob explosion (e.g. Creeper explosion). | style="text-align:center" | {{cd|true}} | Bool | {{tc|no|''Java Edition'' exclusive}} |- | {{Nowrap|{{el|je|short=1}}: {{va|projectiles_can_break_blocks}}}}
{{el|be|short=1}}: {{va|projectilescanbreakblocks}} | Whether impact projectiles destroy blocks that are destructible by them, i.e. [[chorus flower]]s, [[pointed dripstone]], and [[decorated pot]]s. | style="text-align:center" | {{cd|true}} | Bool | {{tc|yes|Without cheats}} |- | {{el|je|short=1}}: {{va|tnt_explosion_drop_decay}}
{{el|be|short=1}}: {{va|tntexplosiondropdecay}} | Whether block loot is dropped by all blocks ({{cd|false}}) or randomly ({{cd|true}}) depending on how far the block is from the center of a TNT explosion. | style="text-align:center" | {{cd|false}} | Bool | {{tc|yes|Without cheats}} |}
